name: Nickel sulfate hexahydrate
description: Nickel sulfate hexahydrate (CAS 10101-97-0 ) is the primary nickel salt used in electroplating and surface finishing operations. It supplies soluble nickel ions to plating baths, enabling controlled deposition of nickel onto metal substrates. Across electronics, metalworking, and battery material manufacturing, it functions as the foundational nickel source in both process chemistry and catalyst preparation. In electroplating, it is the core electrolyte component. It is used in Watts baths and sulfamate-based systems to plate connectors, automotive parts, and consumer hardware. Battery cathode precursor manufacturing relies on it as a nickel feedstock for producing active materials. These materials include nickel-cobalt-manganese (NCM) and nickel-cobalt-aluminum (NCA). In catalyst production, it serves as a precursor for hydrogenation catalysts used in edible oil processing and petrochemical refining. Agricultural micronutrient formulations incorporate it to correct nickel deficiency in crops, particularly in legume cultivation. The product is supplied as blue-green crystalline granules or powder for industrial use. Standard commercial grades include electroplating grade, battery grade, and technical grade. Purity levels typically range from 98% to 99.5%+, ensuring performance across various chemical applications. High-purity battery-grade material is subject to tighter specifications on trace metal impurities.
